scope: Local compression on identical frozen public HTTP bytes and synthetic DAT. Sequential reused encoder with fresh owned output and no result cache; encoding/GC included, reads/reference checks excluded. No full HTTP/WAN/browser/deployment speed claim.
baseline_method: Product encoder from 4e93768 copied as baselineencode; same updated benchmark source as final, with CPU metrics. Originals kept in artifact directory.

small-huffman.decision: Rejected: captured frame sizes unchanged; forced tiny subject encoding slower

full-short.decision: Rejected: large frames reduced only 0.1-0.2 percent while time increased 7-76 percent

two-way.decision: Rejected: minor reduction and some frames grew

predefined.decision: Restricted: full HTTP evaluation slowed large frames without reducing them

predefined-retained.decision: Adopted: restrict to small HTTP and integrate predefined cost into retained-table selection

validation.code_vectors: 110 length/offset codes in predefined frames match independent Go and product decoder; truncated/trailing/wrong-length rejected
validation.table_vectors: 12 known RFC Appendix A states matched; all 160 state transitions bounded
validation.tls: old v10 -> 200/new v11 -> 304/identity DAT range -> 206; new small body fixture passed normal and race
validation.frames: 44 new/old frames match original bytes, independent Go and libzstd; 88 archive outputs byte-identical
validation.bootstrap_targeted: network compression cache and diagnostics passed
validation.final_decoder_guard: code21-28 rejected before bit extraction; normal/race passed; 20s FuzzDecode passed 5899 executions
validation.designcheck: 86 Markdown files, 92 JSON files, 743 local links and synthetic format checks passed
